demo.selection_reason: Mean WAPE across every rolling selection fold; ties use WAPE variability, sMAPE, MASE and forecast stability.

comparison.reason: N-BEATS skipped: at least 512 periods are required in every training fold.

trials.reason: N-BEATS skipped: at least 512 periods are required in every training fold.

calibration.method: Prequential signed-residual quantiles with finite-rank correction

notes: Trend is a descriptive linear slope; seasonality uses a training-history ACF heuristic.
Outliers use 3.5 scaled median absolute deviations and are not removed.
Global importance summarizes up to 200 recent training rows.
Contributions explain this tree model's raw point prediction, before nonnegative clipping and residual calibration.
Positive/negative contributions are relative to the SHAP expected value, not causal effects or changes from yesterday.
Correlated lags can share attribution. A candidate explanation is not the champion's explanation unless its model name matches.
Global importance summarizes up to 200 recent training rows.
Contributions explain this tree model's raw point prediction, before nonnegative clipping and residual calibration.
Positive/negative contributions are relative to the SHAP expected value, not causal effects or changes from yesterday.
Correlated lags can share attribution. A candidate explanation is not the champion's explanation unless its model name matches.

assumptions: Independent series models are fitted on demand; no all-catalog heavyweight training.
Price is held at its last observed value; future event flags are zero. Inventory is excluded from model features.
Calibration observations and final test observations are excluded from parameter/model selection.
Residuals are pooled across forecast leads. P10/P50/P90 are marginal empirical estimates, not joint path bounds.
Temporal dependence and model refits mean nominal 80% coverage is not guaranteed. Assess the measured final-test coverage.
The test period is scored once after selection; production models are then refitted using all history (or the selected rolling window).
N-BEATS requires 512 periods in every training window and an installed optional PyTorch runtime.
